adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema (`addGuests.schema.ts`) only validates email format and does not enforce uniqueness, and the handler’s `uniqueGuests` filter only excludes emails already in `booking.attendees` or blacklisted (`addGuests.handler.ts`), not duplicates within the incoming `guests` array. As a result, a direct API call like `["a@x.com","a@x.com"]` will produce duplicate entries in `guestsFullDetails` and attempt `createMany` with duplicates, which can create duplicate attendee rows or fail if a DB unique constraint exists.
